<font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">使用教程</font><br>
<font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">1找到everything在C盘的路径，通常是C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Roaming\Everything</font><br>
<font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">2新建HTTP Server文件夹，将文件解压，把html文件放入HTTP Server文件夹然后重命名成index即可</font><br>
<font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">3访问本机ip+端口即可</font><br>
<font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">4.</font><font face="Tahoma, Microsoft Yahei, Simsun">everything 选项里的默认页面一定要选</font><font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">index.html</font><br>
<font face="Tahoma,"><br>
</font><br>
<font face="Tahoma, &amp;quot;">手机端浏览也流畅，推荐谷歌浏览器</font><font face="Tahoma,"><br>
</font><br>
html代码附件上传不了，放 <font color="#000"><font face="monospace"><font size="3">蓝奏了：</font></font></font>https://wozai.lanzout.com/ii9F54cngo0f<br>

&lt;div class="sheet-mask" id="mask"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
<br>
&lt;!-- 语法帮助 --&gt;<br>
&lt;section class="sheet" id="helpSheet" role="dialog" aria-label="搜索语法"&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="grab"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;h3&gt;Everything 搜索语法&lt;/h3&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="synlist"&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;报告 2024&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;同时包含「报告」和「2024」&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;报告|总结&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;包含任一关键词（OR）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;!临时&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;排除包含「临时」的结果&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;ext:mp4;mkv&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;按扩展名筛选&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;size:&gt;500mb&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;大于 500MB 的文件&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;dm:last7days&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;最近 7 天修改&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;path:C:\Photos&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;限定目录（含子目录）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;parent:&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;只列该目录的直接子项（浏览目录用）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;folder:&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;只显示文件夹&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;file:&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;只显示文件&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;regex:^IMG_\d+&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;正则匹配（需勾选 .*）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;wfn:&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;通配符整名匹配&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;h3 style="margin-top:18px"&gt;搜索框下方这排按钮&lt;/h3&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="synlist"&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;名称&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;排序依据：名称 / 路径 / 大小 / 修改时间&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;升序&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;点一下切成降序，再点切回来&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;图片&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;只看常用图片格式（jpg / png / gif / webp / heic 等）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;视频&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;只看常用视频格式（mp4 / mkv / avi / mov / rmvb 等）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;Aa&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;区分大小写。不开时 Report 和 report 都算命中&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;全字&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;全字匹配。开了之后搜 &lt;code&gt;log&lt;/code&gt; 不会命中 &lt;code&gt;catalog&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;路径&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;关键词也去匹配完整路径，而不只是文件名&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;.*&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;把关键词当正则表达式（需 Everything 支持该语法）&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;div class="syn"&gt;&lt;code&gt;50 条/页&lt;/code&gt;&lt;span&gt;每页显示多少条，滚动到底会自动加载下一页&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;p class="tip"&gt;&lt;b&gt;图片 / 视频&lt;/b&gt; 是一个「叠加条件」：它不会清空你输入的关键词，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;而是在后面追加 &lt;code&gt;ext:jpg;png;…&lt;/code&gt;，所以「伊蕾娜 + 图片」= 名字含伊蕾娜的图片。&lt;br&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;两个按钮互斥，再点一次即可取消；也可以直接手写 &lt;code&gt;ext:&lt;/code&gt; 达到同样效果（多值用&lt;b&gt;分号&lt;/b&gt;分隔）。&lt;br&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;浏览目录时开启它，只显示该目录下的图片 / 视频；此时「文件夹 / 文件」划分会隐藏，改为显示一个可取消的标记。&lt;br&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;开关状态会存在浏览器本地，并同步到地址栏 &lt;code&gt;#k=image&lt;/code&gt;，刷新和前进后退都保留。&lt;/p&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;p class="tip"&gt;提示：以上语法由 Everything 服务端解析，本页只是把关键词原样传过去。&lt;br&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;浏览目录时本页用 &lt;code&gt;parent:&lt;/code&gt; 逐层列出子项，含义等同于原版的「索引 / 上一目录…」。&lt;br&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;点击结果行即可预览文件或进入文件夹；右侧两个按钮分别是「复制路径」与「下载 / 检索目录」。&lt;/p&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="acts2"&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &lt;button class="btn primary" data-close&gt;知道了&lt;/button&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&lt;/section&gt;<br>
<br>
&lt;!-- 连接设置 --&gt;<br>
&lt;section class="sheet" id="cfgSheet" role="dialog" aria-label="连接设置"&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="grab"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;h3&gt;连接设置&lt;/h3&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="kv"&gt;&lt;span class="k"&gt;服务地址&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="v"&gt;&lt;input id="cfgBase" type="url" inputmode="url" placeholder="留空 = 使用当前地址"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="kv"&gt;&lt;span class="k"&gt;当前地址&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="v" id="cfgOrigin"&gt;—&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;div class="kv"&gt;&lt;span class="k"&gt;状态&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="v" id="cfgState"&gt;—&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;p class="tip"&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 本页由 Everything 自身的 HTTP 服务器托管时为同源访问，无需任何配置。&lt;br&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 若把本页放到别的本地服务器上打开，需在此填写 Everything 的服务地址（例如 http://127.0.0.1:43927）。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 跨源请求要求目标服务器允许 CORS，且无法携带登录凭据 —— 此时建议改用附带的 serve.py 反向代理。<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;<br>

}<br>
function fmtSize(n){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(n==null||n==='') return '';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const s=String(n).trim();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s)){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return /[a-z]/i.test(s) ? s : '';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let b=Number(s); if(!isFinite(b)||b&lt;0) return '';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(b&lt;1024) return b+' B';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const u=['KB','MB','GB','TB','PB']; let i=-1;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;do{ b/=1024; i++; }while(b&gt;=1024 &amp;&amp; i&lt;u.length-1);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return (b&gt;=100?b.toFixed(0):b&gt;=10?b.toFixed(1):b.toFixed(2))+' '+u<i>;<br>
}<br>
/* Everything 返回 date_modified 为 Windows FILETIME（1601 起 100ns） */<br>
function parseTime(v){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(v==null||v===''||v==='0') return null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const s=String(v);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(/^\d{17,}$/.test(s)){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; try{ const ms=Number(BigInt(s)/10000n)-11644473600000; const d=new Date(ms); return isNaN(d)?null:d; }catch(e){ return null; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(/^\d{10}$/.test(s)){ const d=new Date(Number(s)*1000); return isNaN(d)?null:d; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const d=new Date(s); return isNaN(d)?null:d;<br>
}<br>
const DAY=86400000;<br>
function fmtTime(d){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!d) return '';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const now=new Date();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const diff=now-d;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(diff&gt;=0&amp;&amp;diff&lt;DAY&amp;&amp;d.getDate()===now.getDate())<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return '今天 '+String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(diff&gt;=0&amp;&amp;diff&lt;DAY*2) return '昨天 '+String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const p=n=&gt;String(n).padStart(2,'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const y=d.getFullYear()===now.getFullYear()?'' : d.getFullYear()+'-';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return y+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate())+' '+p(d.getHours())+':'+p(d.getMinutes());<br>
}<br>

function iconFor(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(item.type==='folder') return CATS[0];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const name=(item.name||'').toLowerCase();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ext=name.indexOf('.')&gt;-1 ? name.split('.').pop() : '';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;for(let i=1;i&lt;CATS.length;i++){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(CATS<i>.e &amp;&amp; CATS<i>.e.split(' ').indexOf(ext)&gt;-1) return CATS<i>;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return CATS[CATS.length-1];<br>
}<br>
function svgIcon(path,color,fill){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const svg=document.createElementNS(ns,'svg');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 24 24');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(fill){ svg.setAttribute('fill',color); svg.setAttribute('stroke',color); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else { svg.setAttribute('fill','none'); svg.setAttribute('stroke',color); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;svg.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.8');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;svg.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;svg.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin','round');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const p=document.createElementNS(ns,'path');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.setAttribute('d',path); svg.appendChild(p);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return svg;<br>
}<br>
function joinPath(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const p=(item.path||'').replace(/\\+$/,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!p) return item.name||'';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return p+'\\'+(item.name||'');<br>
}<br>
function fileUrl(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const full=joinPath(item).replace(/\\/g,'/');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return '/'+full.split('/').filter(Boolean).map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ================= 交给手机上的外部 App（Android intent: 链接） =================<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;Chrome for Android 支持用 intent: 链接把 URL 丢给已安装的 App。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;**不写 package= 时，Android 会弹出系统自己的「打开方式」列表**，由你挑 MX Player / VLC 之类，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;这正是「让我选择我安装的播放器」。两个硬性条件（来自 Chrome 官方文档）：<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;1. 必须带 category=android.intent.category.BROWSABLE，否则任何 App 都拉不起来；<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;2. 必须由真实用户点击触发，JS 定时器触发会被直接拦掉 —— 所以只能挂在 &lt;a href&gt; 上。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;另外微信内置浏览器会拦截这类跳转，所以微信里改成给出提示。 */<br>
const MIME_BY_EXT={<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;jpg:'image/jpeg',jpeg:'image/jpeg',jfif:'image/jpeg',jpe:'image/jpeg',png:'image/png',apng:'image/apng',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;gif:'image/gif',webp:'image/webp',bmp:'image/bmp',avif:'image/avif',ico:'image/x-icon',cur:'image/x-icon',<br>

&nbsp;&nbsp;mkv:'video/x-matroska',avi:'video/x-msvideo',wmv:'video/x-ms-wmv',flv:'video/x-flv',f4v:'video/x-f4v',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;mpg:'video/mpeg',mpeg:'video/mpeg',m2ts:'video/mp2t',mts:'video/mp2t',ts:'video/mp2t',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;'3gp':'video/3gpp','3g2':'video/3gpp2',vob:'video/mpeg',asf:'video/x-ms-asf',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;rm:'application/vnd.rn-realmedia',rmvb:'application/vnd.rn-realmedia',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;mp3:'audio/mpeg',wav:'audio/wav',m4a:'audio/mp4',aac:'audio/aac',ogg:'audio/ogg',oga:'audio/ogg',<br>

};<br>
const IS_ANDROID=/android/i.test(navigator.userAgent||'');<br>
const IS_WECHAT=/micromessenger/i.test(navigator.userAgent||'');<br>
/* 这几种类型交给外部 App 才有意义 */<br>
const INTENT_KINDS=['image','vector','video','audio','pdf'];<br>
function mimeOf(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const m=MIME_BY_EXT[extOf(item.name)];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(m) return m;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const k=kindOf(item);&nbsp; &nbsp;/* 兜底用通配，保证系统列表里能列出相关 App */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return k==='video' ? 'video/*' : k==='audio' ? 'audio/*' : k==='pdf' ? 'application/pdf' : 'image/*';<br>
}<br>
function intentHref(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const href=new URL(fileUrl(item),location.href).href;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;/* intent:// 后面跟的是「去掉 scheme 的完整地址」，路径里的 %XX 必须原样保留，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Android 侧才能还原出正确的 http 地址（含盘符的 %3A）。额外把 # 转义掉。 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const target=href.replace(/^https?:\/\//i,'').replace(/#/g,'%23');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return 'intent://'+target+'#Intent;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'scheme='+location.protocol.replace(':','')+';'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'action=android.intent.action.VIEW;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'category=android.intent.category.BROWSABLE;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'type='+mimeOf(item)+';'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'S.browser_fallback_url='+encodeURIComponent(href)+';'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; 'end';<br>
}<br>
function vBtnIntent(label,href){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const a=document.createElement('a');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 不要 target=_blank：intent: 链接需要留在当前页触发跳转 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;a.className='vbtn wide intent'; a.href=href;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;a.innerHTML='&lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"&gt;&lt;path d="'+IP.ext+'"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const sp=document.createElement('span'); sp.textContent=label; a.appendChild(sp);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return a;<br>
}<br>
function intentBtn(item,kind){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!IS_ANDROID || INTENT_KINDS.indexOf(kind)&lt;0) return null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(IS_WECHAT){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return vBtn('改用浏览器打开',IP.ext,false,()=&gt;toast('微信会拦截外部应用跳转：点右上角「···」→「在浏览器打开」，再点这个按钮'));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const media=(kind==='video'||kind==='audio');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const b=vBtnIntent(media?'用其它播放器打开':'用其它应用打开',intentHref(item));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;b.title='交给手机上已安装的播放器 / 看图应用（会弹出系统的「打开方式」列表）';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return b;<br>
}<br>
async function copyText(t){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(navigator.clipboard &amp;&amp; window.isSecureContext){ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const ta=document.createElement('textarea');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;ta.value=t; ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;opacity:0';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; toast('路径已复制');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}catch(e){ toast('复制失败，请手动选择'); }<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 目录与文件类型 ======================= */<br>
/* 规范化目录：去尾部反斜杠，但盘符根保留 'D:\' */<br>
function normDir(p){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let d=String(p||'').replace(/[\\/]+$/,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(/^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(d)) d+='\\';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return d;<br>
}<br>
/* 上一级目录；盘符根返回 null（= 回到磁盘列表） */<br>
function parentOf(dir){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const d=normDir(dir).replace(/\\$/,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const i=d.lastIndexOf('\\');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(i&lt;=0) return null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const up=d.slice(0,i);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return /^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(up)?up+'\\':up;<br>
}<br>
/* 浏览用搜索语句：parent:"目录" */<br>
function parentQuery(dir){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const d=normDir(dir).replace(/"/g,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let s='parent:"'+d+'"';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 开了「图片 / 视频」就优先按扩展名过滤：ext: 本身只命中文件，不会带出文件夹 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const f=quickOn();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(f) s+=' ext:'+f.exts;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else if(state.browseType==='folder') s+=' folder:';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else if(state.browseType==='file') s+=' file:';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return s;<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* 可预览类型 */<br>
const KIND={<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;image:'jpg jpeg jfif png gif webp bmp avif ico cur',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;vector:'svg',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;video:'mp4 m4v webm ogv mov mkv avi wmv flv ts mpg mpeg 3gp',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;audio:'mp3 wav m4a aac ogg oga opus flac wma ape aiff mid midi',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;pdf:'pdf',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;text:'txt md markdown log nfo ini cfg conf json json5 xml yml yaml toml csv tsv js mjs cjs jsx ts tsx css scss sass less styl html htm xhtml vue svelte astro py pyw java c h hpp cpp cc cxx cs go rs php rb swift kt kts scala sql sh bash zsh fish bat cmd ps1 psd1 lua dart r m mm pl pm groovy gradle properties env gitignore gitattributes editorconfig dockerfile makefile cmake mk srt vtt ass ssa lrc reg patch diff po pot strings'<br>
};<br>
const KIND_ALIAS={ markdown:'text', yml:'text', htm:'text', mjs:'text', ts:'text' };<br>
<br>
/* 「图片 / 视频」快捷过滤用的常用扩展名。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;注意：Everything 的 ext: 多值必须用分号分隔——竖线会被当成 OR 关键词、<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;逗号直接搜不到东西（都实测过）。 */<br>
const QUICK={<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;image:{ label:'图片', exts:'jpg;jpeg;jfif;jpe;png;apng;gif;webp;bmp;avif;svg;ico;cur;tif;tiff;heic;heif' },<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;video:{ label:'视频', exts:'mp4;m4v;mov;webm;ogv;mkv;avi;wmv;flv;f4v;mpg;mpeg;m2ts;mts;ts;3gp;3g2;vob;rm;rmvb;asf' }<br>
};<br>
function quickOn(){ return state.quick &amp;&amp; QUICK[state.quick] ? QUICK[state.quick] : null; }<br>
/* 把快捷过滤拼到用户输入后面（空格在 Everything 里是 AND） */<br>
function applyQuick(q){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const f=quickOn();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return f ? ((q? q+' ' : '')+'ext:'+f.exts) : q;<br>
}<br>
/* 状态栏 / 空态提示里显示的「图片 / 视频」字样 */<br>
function quickTag(){ const f=quickOn(); return f?f.label:''; }<br>
function extOf(name){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const n=String(name||'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const i=n.lastIndexOf('.');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return i&gt;0 ? n.slice(i+1).toLowerCase() : '';<br>
}<br>
function kindOf(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(item.type==='folder') return 'folder';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ext=extOf(item.name);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!ext) return 'text'; /* 无扩展名多半是文本，例如 hosts / LICENSE */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;for(const k in KIND){ if(KIND[k].split(' ').indexOf(ext)&gt;-1) return k; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return 'other';<br>
}<br>
/* 文本解码：UTF-8 优先，失败退回 GB18030（中文老文件常见）<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;partial=true 表示数据是被截断的，末字节可能切在多字节字符中间 */<br>
function decodeText(buf,partial){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let b=new Uint8Array(buf);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(b.length&gt;=3 &amp;&amp; b[0]===0xEF &amp;&amp; b[1]===0xBB &amp;&amp; b[2]===0xBF) b=b.subarray(3);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{ return new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(b); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;catch(e){}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(partial){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; /* 回退最多 3 字节，凑齐被切断的 UTF-8 序列 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; for(let k=1;k&lt;=3&amp;&amp;k&lt;b.length;k++){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;try{ return new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(b.subarray(0,b.length-k)); }catch(e2){}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const tries=['gb18030','gbk','big5','shift_jis','euc-kr','windows-1252'];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;for(let i=0;i&lt;tries.length;i++){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; try{ return new TextDecoder(tries<i>).decode(b); }catch(e){}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(b);<br>
}<br>
/* 从 Content-Range: bytes 0-0/1234 里取出总长度 */<br>
function totalFromRange(v){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const m=String(v||'').match(/\/(\d+)\s*$/);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return m ? Number(m[1]) : null;<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 状态 ======================= */<br>
const state={<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;q:'',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;mode:'idle',&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; /* idle | search | browse */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;browse:null,&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; /* 正在浏览的目录，规范化后：'D:\' 或 'D:\Games' */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;browseType:'all',&nbsp;&nbsp;/* all | folder | file */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;quick:store.get('quick','')||null,&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 快捷类型过滤：null | 'image' | 'video' */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;drives:null,&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; /* 磁盘列表，懒加载 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;sort:store.get('sort','name'),<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;asc:store.get('asc',true),<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;flags:{ caseSensitive:store.get('case',false), wholeword:store.get('wholeword',false), path:store.get('path',false), regex:store.get('regex',false) },<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;pageSize:store.get('pageSize',50),<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;base:store.get('base',''),<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;theme:store.get('theme','auto'),<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;history:store.get('history',[]),<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;total:0, shown:0, loading:false<br>
};<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 主题 ======================= */<br>
const ICONS={<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;auto:'&lt;path d="M12 3a9 9 0 100 18 9 9 0 000-18z"/&gt;&lt;path d="M12 3a9 9 0 010 18z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/&gt;',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;light:'&lt;circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.2"/&gt;&lt;path d="M12 2.6v2.2M12 19.2v2.2M4.4 4.4l1.6 1.6M18 18l1.6 1.6M2.6 12h2.2M19.2 12h2.2M4.4 19.6L6 18M18 6l1.6-1.6"/&gt;',<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;dark:'&lt;path d="M20 14.2A8.4 8.4 0 019.8 4a8.6 8.6 0 1010.2 10.2z"/&gt;'<br>
};<br>
function applyTheme(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',state.theme);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#themeIcon').innerHTML=ICONS[state.theme];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const dark=state.theme==='dark'||(state.theme==='auto'&amp;&amp;window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme:dark)').matches);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let m=$('meta[name="theme-color"]'); if(!m){ m=document.createElement('meta'); m.name='theme-color'; document.head.appendChild(m); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;m.content=dark?'#0f1114':'#f4f5f7';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;store.set('theme',state.theme);<br>
}<br>
$('#themeBtn').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.theme=state.theme==='auto'?'light':state.theme==='light'?'dark':'auto';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;applyTheme();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;toast({auto:'主题：跟随系统',light:'主题：浅色',dark:'主题：深色'}[state.theme]);<br>
});<br>

/* ======================= URL 同步 ======================= */<br>
function syncUrl(push){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const p=new URLSearchParams();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.browse) p.set('b',state.browse);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else if(state.q) p.set('q',state.q);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.sort!=='name'||!state.asc){ p.set('sort',state.sort); p.set('asc',state.asc?'1':'0'); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.browse &amp;&amp; state.browseType!=='all' &amp;&amp; !state.quick) p.set('bt',state.browseType);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.quick) p.set('k',state.quick);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const f=state.flags; const on=[];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(f.caseSensitive) on.push('case'); if(f.wholeword) on.push('wholeword'); if(f.path) on.push('path'); if(f.regex) on.push('regex');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(on.length) p.set('opt',on.join(','));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const s=p.toString();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const url=location.pathname+location.search+(s?'#'+s:'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;history[push?'pushState':'replaceState'](null,'',url);<br>
}<br>
function readUrl(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const h=location.hash.replace(/^#/,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const p=new URLSearchParams(h);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.browse = p.has('b') ? (p.get('b')||null) : null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.q = state.browse ? '' : (p.has('q') ? (p.get('q')||'') : '');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.browseType = p.has('bt') ? (p.get('bt')||'all') : 'all';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;{ const k=p.get('k')||''; state.quick = QUICK[k] ? k : null; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(p.has('sort')) state.sort=p.get('sort')||'name';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(p.has('asc')) state.asc=p.get('asc')==='1';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(p.has('opt')){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const on=(p.get('opt')||'').split(',');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.flags={ caseSensitive:on.indexOf('case')&gt;-1, wholeword:on.indexOf('wholeword')&gt;-1, path:on.indexOf('path')&gt;-1, regex:on.indexOf('regex')&gt;-1 };<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 界面同步 ======================= */<br>
function paintControls(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#q').value=state.q;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('.searchwrap').classList.toggle('has-value',!!state.q);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#sortSel').value=state.sort;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#pageSel').value=String(state.pageSize);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const asc=$('#ascBtn');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;asc.classList.toggle('on',!state.asc);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;asc.innerHTML=state.asc<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; ? '升序 &lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"&gt;&lt;path d="M7 4v16M7 4l-3.5 3.5M7 4l3.5 3.5"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;'<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; : '降序 &lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"&gt;&lt;path d="M7 20V4M7 20l-3.5-3.5M7 20l3.5-3.5"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$$('#filters .chip[data-flag]').forEach(b=&gt;b.classList.toggle('on',!!state.flags[b.dataset.flag]));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$$('#filters .chip[data-quick]').forEach(b=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const on=state.quick===b.dataset.quick;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.classList.toggle('on',on);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
}<br>
function status(html,spinning){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const el=$('#status');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!html){ el.hidden=true; el.innerHTML=''; return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;el.hidden=false;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;el.innerHTML=(spinning?'&lt;span class="spin"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;':'')+'&lt;span&gt;'+html+'&lt;/span&gt;';<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 首页提示 ======================= */<br>
const ICON_DRIVE='M3.6 5.8h16.8v10.4H3.6zM3.6 12.4h16.8M6.4 15.2h2.6M15 15.2h2.6';<br>
const ICON_UP='M12 19.2V6.4M12 6.4 6.9 11.5M12 6.4l5.1 5.1';<br>
function paintHome(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const box=$('#home');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.mode!=='idle'){ box.innerHTML=''; return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const h=state.history.slice(0,8);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let html='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.drives &amp;&amp; state.drives.length){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; html+='&lt;div class="secttl"&gt;索引 · 按磁盘浏览&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="drives"&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;state.drives.map(d=&gt;'&lt;button class="drivecard" data-dir="'+d+'\\" type="button"&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'&lt;span class="di"&gt;&lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"&gt;&lt;path d="'+ICON_DRIVE+'"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'&lt;span class="dt"&gt;'+d+'&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="ds"&gt;索引 '+d+'&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/button&gt;').join('')+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;/div&gt;';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(h.length){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; html+='&lt;div class="secttl"&gt;最近搜索&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="history"&gt;'+h.map(t=&gt;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="hchip" data-hq="'+t.replace(/"/g,'"')+'"&gt;&lt;span class="t"&gt;'+t.replace(/[&lt;&amp;]/g,c=&gt;c==='&lt;'?'&lt;':'&amp;')+'&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;button class="x" data-hdel="'+t.replace(/"/g,'"')+'" aria-label="移除"&gt;&lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round"&gt;&lt;path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;&lt;/button&gt;&lt;/span&gt;'<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; ).join('')+'&lt;/div&gt;';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;html+='&lt;div class="hint" style="margin-top:'+((state.drives&amp;&amp;state.drives.length)||h.length?'14px':'4px')+'"&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; '&lt;h2&gt;搜索文件，或者按目录浏览&lt;/h2&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; '&lt;p&gt;点上方磁盘进入目录浏览，逐层查看文件夹结构（等同于原版的「索引 / 上一目录…」）。&lt;br&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; '在搜索结果里点击文件夹也能直接进去；点击文件即可预览。&lt;/p&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; '&lt;div class="codegrid"&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="code"&gt;&lt;b&gt;ext:&lt;/b&gt;pdf&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="code"&gt;&lt;b&gt;size:&lt;/b&gt;&gt;100mb&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="code"&gt;&lt;b&gt;dm:&lt;/b&gt;last7days&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="code"&gt;&lt;b&gt;path:&lt;/b&gt;D:\\Work&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="code"&gt;报告|总结&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'&lt;span class="code"&gt;!临时&lt;/span&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; '&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;box.innerHTML=html;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.drives===null &amp;&amp; !homeLoading){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; homeLoading=true;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; ensureDrives().then(()=&gt;{ homeLoading=false; if(state.mode==='idle') paintHome(); });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
}<br>
let homeLoading=false;<br>
async function ensureDrives(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.drives!==null) return state.drives;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const res=await request('root:',0,40);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.drives=(res.items||[])<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.filter(x=&gt;/^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(x.name||''))<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.map(x=&gt;x.name.toUpperCase())<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.filter((v,i,a)=&gt;a.indexOf(v)===i);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}catch(e){ state.drives=[]; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return state.drives;<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 结果渲染 ======================= */<br>
function highlight(el,text,terms){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!terms.length){ el.textContent=text; return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const re=new RegExp('('+terms.map(esc).join('|')+')','gi');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const parts=text.split(re);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;el.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;parts.forEach((p,i)=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(!p) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(i%2===1){ const m=document.createElement('mark'); m.textContent=p; el.appendChild(m); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; else el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(p));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
}<br>
function termsOf(q){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return q.split(/\s+/).filter(t=&gt;t &amp;&amp; !/[:!|&lt;&gt;*?\\]/.test(t) &amp;&amp; t.length&gt;0 &amp;&amp; t.length&lt;=32).slice(0,4);<br>
}<br>
function makeCard(item,idx,terms){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const node=$('#tplCard').content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const cat=iconFor(item);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ic=node.querySelector('.ficon');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;ic.style.background=cat.bg;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;ic.appendChild(svgIcon(cat.d,cat.c,cat.k==='folder'));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.querySelector('.fname').appendChild(document.createElement('span'));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;highlight(node.querySelector('.fname span'),item.name||'(未命名)',terms);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const pEl=node.querySelector('.fpath');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.mode==='browse'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pEl.remove();&nbsp; &nbsp;/* 浏览目录时每行路径都一样，交给顶部面包屑，列表更接近原版的「名称/大小/时间」 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pEl.textContent=item.path||'';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pEl.title=joinPath(item);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const sub=node.querySelector('.fsub');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const size=fmtSize(item.size);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const t=fmtTime(parseTime(item.date_modified!=null?item.date_modified:item.date_created));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const bits=[];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(item.type==='folder'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; bits.push(['文件夹','']);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(size) bits.push([size,'sz']);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else if(size){ bits.push([size,'sz']); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(t) bits.push([t,'dt']);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!bits.length) bits.push([item.type==='file'?'文件':'—','']);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;bits.forEach((b,i)=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(i){ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='dot'; sub.appendChild(d); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const s=document.createElement('span');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; s.className=b[1];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; s.textContent=b[0]; sub.appendChild(s);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.querySelector('.copy').addEventListener('click',e=&gt;{ e.stopPropagation(); copyText(joinPath(item)); });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const open=node.querySelector('.open');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(item.type==='folder'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 右侧按钮：在本页内检索该目录（整行点击则是逐层浏览该目录）<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.removeAttribute('target');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.setAttribute('href',fileUrl(item));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.setAttribute('aria-label','在本页内搜索该目录');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.title='搜索该目录下的内容';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.innerHTML='&lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"&gt;&lt;circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.2"/&gt;&lt;path d="m19.6 19.6-4.2-4.2"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.addEventListener('click',ev=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;$('#q').value='path:"'+joinPath(item)+'"';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;runSearch(true);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.href=fileUrl(item);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.setAttribute('download',item.name||'');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.setAttribute('aria-label','下载文件');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; open.title='下载文件';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;// 整行可点：目录 → 进入目录浏览；文件 → 打开预览<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.tabIndex=0;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.setAttribute('role','button');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.setAttribute('aria-label',(item.type==='folder'?'进入目录 ':'预览 ')+(item.name||''));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const activate=()=&gt;{ if(item.type==='folder') enterBrowse(joinPath(item)); else openViewer(item); };<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.addEventListener('click',e=&gt;{ if(e.target.closest('.acts')) return; activate(); });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;node.addEventListener('keydown',e=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); activate(); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return node;<br>
}<br>
function pushItems(items,terms,append){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const box=$('#results');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!append) box.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;items.forEach((it,i)=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const c=makeCard(it,i,terms);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; c.style.animationDelay=Math.min(i,12)*14+'ms';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; frag.appendChild(c);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;box.appendChild(frag);<br>
}<br>
function skeleton(n){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const box=$('#results'); box.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;for(let i=0;i&lt;n;i++){ const d=document.createElement('div'); d.className='skel'; box.appendChild(d); }<br>
}<br>
function paintMore(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const w=$('#morewrap');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.mode==='idle'){ w.innerHTML=''; return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.shown&lt;state.total){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; w.innerHTML='&lt;button class="morebtn" id="moreBtn"&gt;加载更多（已显示 '+state.shown+' / 共 '+state.total+'）&lt;/button&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; '&lt;div class="endnote"&gt;下滑或点击继续加载&lt;/div&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#moreBtn').addEventListener('click',loadMore);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; w.innerHTML=state.total&gt;0?'&lt;div class="endnote"&gt;已显示全部 '+state.total+(state.mode==='browse'?' 项':' 条结果')+'&lt;/div&gt;':'';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
}<br>
function loadMore(){ if(state.mode==='browse') loadBrowse(false); else load(false); }<br>
function reloadCurrent(){ if(state.mode==='browse') loadBrowse(true); else if(state.mode==='search') load(true); }<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 目录浏览 ======================= */<br>
function makeUpRow(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const dir=state.browse, up=parentOf(dir);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const row=document.createElement('div');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;row.className='uprow';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ic=document.createElement('span'); ic.className='uic';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;ic.appendChild(svgIcon(ICON_UP,'currentColor'));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const box=document.createElement('div'); box.className='fmeta';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const t=document.createElement('div'); t.className='ut';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const s=document.createElement('div'); s.className='up';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(up){ t.textContent='上一目录…'; s.textContent=up; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else{ t.textContent='返回磁盘列表'; s.textContent='上一目录…'; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;box.appendChild(t); box.appendChild(s);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;row.appendChild(ic); row.appendChild(box);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;row.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{ up ? enterBrowse(up) : exitBrowse(); });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return row;<br>
}<br>
function paintBrowseBar(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const bar=$('#browsebar');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!state.browse){ bar.classList.remove('show'); bar.textContent=''; return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;bar.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;bar.classList.add('show');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const dir=normDir(state.browse);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const segs=dir.replace(/\\$/,'').split('\\').filter(Boolean);&nbsp; &nbsp;/* ['D:','Games'] */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const row=document.createElement('div'); row.className='crumbrow';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const crumb=document.createElement('div'); crumb.className='crumb';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const idx=document.createElement('span'); idx.className='idx'; idx.textContent='索引';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;crumb.appendChild(idx);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;segs.forEach((sg,i)=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(i){ const sp=document.createElement('span'); sp.className='sep'; sp.textContent='&amp;#8250;'; crumb.appendChild(sp); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const acc=(i===0 ? sg+'\\' : segs.slice(0,i+1).join('\\'));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const isLast=(i===segs.length-1);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const el=document.createElement('span');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; el.className='seg'+(isLast?' cur':' link');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; el.textContent=sg;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(!isLast) el.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;enterBrowse(acc));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; crumb.appendChild(el);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const exit=document.createElement('button');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;exit.type='button'; exit.className='exitbtn';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;exit.innerHTML='&lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"&gt;&lt;path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;返回搜索';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;exit.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;exitBrowse());<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;row.appendChild(crumb); row.appendChild(exit);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;bar.appendChild(row);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const types=document.createElement('div');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;types.className='filters tight';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const qk=quickOn();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(qk){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; /* 开了「图片 / 视频」时，文件夹/文件 的划分已经没有意义，只留一个可取消的标记 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const b=document.createElement('button');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.type='button'; b.className='chip on';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.dataset.quick=state.quick;&nbsp; &nbsp;/* 让分类色样式生效 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.innerHTML='仅'+qk.label+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;' &lt;svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"&gt;&lt;path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.title='取消「仅'+qk.label+'」，显示该目录全部内容';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; b.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;state.quick=null; store.set('quick','');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;paintControls(); syncUrl(false); paintBrowseBar(); loadBrowse(true);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; types.appendChild(b);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; [['all','全部'],['folder','文件夹'],['file','文件']].forEach(([k,label])=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const b=document.createElement('button');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;b.type='button'; b.className='chip'+(state.browseType===k?' on':'');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;b.textContent=label;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;b.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{ state.browseType=k; syncUrl(false); paintBrowseBar(); loadBrowse(true); });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;types.appendChild(b);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;bar.appendChild(types);<br>
}<br>
function enterBrowse(dir){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.browse=normDir(dir);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.q=''; state.browseType='all';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.total=0; state.shown=0;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;syncUrl(true);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;showBrowse();<br>
}<br>
function exitBrowse(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.browse=null; state.mode='idle';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;syncUrl(true);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;resetHome();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#q').focus();<br>
}<br>
function showBrowse(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.mode='browse'; state.q='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#q').value=''; $('.searchwrap').classList.remove('has-value');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#home').innerHTML='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;paintBrowseBar();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;loadBrowse(true);<br>
}<br>
function resetHome(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.mode='idle';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#results').textContent=''; $('#morewrap').innerHTML='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#browsebar').classList.remove('show'); $('#browsebar').textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;paintHome(); status('');<br>
}<br>
async function loadBrowse(initial){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!initial &amp;&amp; state.loading) return;&nbsp; &nbsp;/* 同上：重新读取目录要能打断上一次 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const seq=++reqSeq;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.loading=true;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const offset=initial?0:state.shown;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(initial){ skeleton(6); status('正在读取目录…',true); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else if($('#moreBtn')) $('#moreBtn').disabled=true;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const t0=performance.now();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const res=await request(parentQuery(state.browse),offset,state.pageSize);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(seq!==reqSeq) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.total=res.total;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(initial) state.shown=0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.shown+=res.items.length;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pushItems(res.items,[],!initial);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(initial &amp;&amp; $('#results').firstChild) $('#results').insertBefore(makeUpRow(),$('#results').firstChild);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const ms=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(state.total===0 &amp;&amp; initial){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const tag=quickTag();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const empty=document.createElement('div');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;empty.className='hint';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;empty.innerHTML='&lt;h2&gt;这个目录是空的&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(tag ? '这里没有&lt;b&gt;'+tag+'&lt;/b&gt;文件（当前只显示'+tag+'）。取消「'+tag+'」可以看到其它内容。&lt;br&gt;'<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; : '没有匹配的'+ (state.browseType==='folder'?'子文件夹':state.browseType==='file'?'文件':'内容') +<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;'，或者 Everything 未索引该位置。&lt;br&gt;') +<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'也可能是目录名含特殊字符，试试用搜索框直接搜关键词。&lt;/p&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;$('#results').appendChild(empty);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; status('共 &lt;b&gt;'+state.total+'&lt;/b&gt; 项'+(quickTag()?'（仅'+quickTag()+'）':'')+' · 耗时 '+ms+' ms');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; paintMore();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#cfgState') &amp;&amp; ($('#cfgState').textContent='正常（'+state.total+' 项）');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}catch(e){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(seq!==reqSeq) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#results').textContent='';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const msg=errText(e);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; status('&lt;span class="err"&gt;'+msg+'&lt;/span&gt;');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#morewrap').innerHTML='&lt;button class="morebtn" id="retryBtn"&gt;重试&lt;/button&gt;&lt;button class="morebtn" id="cfgBtn"&gt;连接设置&lt;/button&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#retryBtn').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;loadBrowse(initial));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#cfgBtn').addEventListener('click',openCfg);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}finally{ if(seq===reqSeq) state.loading=false; }<br>
}<br>
function errText(e){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(e.code==='auth') return '需要登录：服务器已设置用户名 / 密码，请先在浏览器中完成一次登录后重试。';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(e.code==='timeout') return '连接超时：Everything 可能未在运行，或端口不正确。';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(e.code==='parse'||e.code==='shape') return '服务器返回的内容不是 Everything 的 JSON 接口，请确认地址指向 Everything HTTP 服务。';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return '无法连接：'+(e.message||'网络错误')+'。请确认 Everything 已启动 HTTP 服务器。';<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 请求 ======================= */<br>
function buildUrl(search,offset,count){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;let base=(state.base||'').trim();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!base) base='./'; else if(!/\/$/.test(base)) base+='/';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const u=new URL(base,location.href);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const p=u.searchParams;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('search',search==null?'':search);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('json','1');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('offset',String(offset));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('count',String(count));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('sort',state.sort);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('ascending',state.asc?'1':'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('case',state.flags.caseSensitive?'1':'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('wholeword',state.flags.wholeword?'1':'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('path',state.flags.path?'1':'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('regex',state.flags.regex?'1':'0');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('path_column','1');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('size_column','1');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;p.set('date_modified_column','1');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;return u;<br>
}<br>
async function request(search,offset,count){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ctl=new AbortController();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const timer=setTimeout(()=&gt;ctl.abort(),20000);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const r=await fetch(buildUrl(search,offset,count).toString(),{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;credentials:'same-origin',<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;cache:'no-store',<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;headers:{ 'Accept':'application/json' },<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;signal:ctl.signal<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(r.status===401) throw Object.assign(new Error('401'),{code:'auth'});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(!r.ok) throw Object.assign(new Error('HTTP '+r.status),{code:'http'});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; let data;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; try{ data=await r.json(); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; catch(e){ throw Object.assign(new Error('响应不是 JSON'),{code:'parse'}); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(data &amp;&amp; data.totalResults==null &amp;&amp; !data.results) throw Object.assign(new Error('响应格式不符'),{code:'shape'});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return { total:Number(data.totalResults||0), items:data.results||[] };<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}catch(e){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(e.name==='AbortError') throw Object.assign(new Error('请求超时'),{code:'timeout'});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; throw e;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}finally{ clearTimeout(timer); }<br>
}<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 搜索 ======================= */<br>
let reqSeq=0;<br>
async function runSearch(push){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const q=$('#q').value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.q=q;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.browse=null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 只点了「图片 / 视频」没输关键词，也算一次有效搜索 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.mode=(q||state.quick)?'search':'idle';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.total=0; state.shown=0;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#home').innerHTML='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#browsebar').classList.remove('show'); $('#browsebar').textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;syncUrl(push===true);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.mode!=='search'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#results').textContent=''; $('#morewrap').innerHTML='';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; paintHome(); status('');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(q) remember(q);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;await load(true);<br>
}<br>
async function load(initial){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 只有「加载更多」才需要防重入；重新搜索必须能打断上一次请求，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;否则快速点「图片/视频」或改关键词时，新搜索会被静默丢弃。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;过期响应由下面的 seq 校验丢弃。 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!initial &amp;&amp; state.loading) return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const seq=++reqSeq;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.loading=true;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const terms=termsOf(state.q);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const offset=initial?0:state.shown;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(initial){ skeleton(6); status('正在搜索…',true); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else{ $('#moreBtn') &amp;&amp; ($('#moreBtn').disabled=true); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const t0=performance.now();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const res=await request(applyQuick(state.q),offset,state.pageSize);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(seq!==reqSeq) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.total=res.total;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(initial) state.shown=0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.shown+=res.items.length;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pushItems(res.items,terms,!initial);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const ms=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const tag=quickTag();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(state.total===0){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;status('没有找到匹配的文件');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;$('#results').innerHTML='&lt;div class="hint"&gt;&lt;h2&gt;没有找到结果&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;'+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(tag?'当前只显示&lt;b&gt;'+tag+'&lt;/b&gt;，试试取消它，或减少关键词。':'试试减少关键词、去掉过滤器，或检查是否拼写有误。')+<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;status('找到 &lt;b&gt;'+state.total+'&lt;/b&gt; 个结果'+(tag?'（仅'+tag+'）':'')+' · 耗时 '+ms+' ms');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; paintMore();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#cfgState') &amp;&amp; ($('#cfgState').textContent='正常（'+state.total+' 条）');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}catch(e){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(seq!==reqSeq) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#results').innerHTML='';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const msg=errText(e);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; status('&lt;span class="err"&gt;'+msg+'&lt;/span&gt;');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#morewrap').innerHTML='&lt;button class="morebtn" id="retryBtn"&gt;重试&lt;/button&gt;&lt;button class="morebtn" id="cfgBtn"&gt;连接设置&lt;/button&gt;';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#retryBtn').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;load(initial));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#cfgBtn').addEventListener('click',openCfg);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; $('#cfgState') &amp;&amp; ($('#cfgState').textContent=msg);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}finally{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; /* 过期的响应不能把标志位清掉，否则会把正在跑的那次请求的防重入给解除 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(seq===reqSeq) state.loading=false;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
}<br>

&nbsp;&nbsp;state.history=h; store.set('history',h);<br>
}<br>

&nbsp;&nbsp;d.appendChild(sp); d.appendChild(t); body.appendChild(d);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 兜底：遮罩铺满整个预览区，万一部分浏览器不派发 load/loadedmetadata 事件，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;就一直挡住原生播放器控件。到点自动撤掉，让用户至少能手动操作。 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;clearTimeout(viewer.loadTimer);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;viewer.loadTimer=setTimeout(vHideLoad,10000);<br>
}<br>

}<br>

&nbsp; &nbsp; box.appendChild(vBtnDownload(item,u));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; box.appendChild(vBtn('复制路径',IP.copy,false,()=&gt;copyText(joinPath(item))));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(kind==='video'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; vLoad('正在加载视频…');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const v=document.createElement('video');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.controls=true; v.playsInline=true; v.preload='metadata';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; /* playsinline / webkit-playsinline 只对 iOS Safari 有意义；<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 安卓 Chrome 明确忽略它（Chrome 官方：Android 不实现自动全屏，该属性 hint 不被使用）。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 安卓上真正会接管播放的是微信 / QQ 用的 X5(TBS) 内核：它不认标准属性，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 会把视频劫持进自己那套全屏播放器（就是那个看着很陌生、还带腾讯界面的播放器）。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 必须单独给 X5 的私有属性，才能让它老老实实留在页面里。 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.setAttribute('playsinline',''); v.setAttribute('webkit-playsinline','');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.setAttribute('x5-playsinline','true');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.setAttribute('x5-video-player-type','h5-page');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.setAttribute('x-webkit-airplay','allow');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; let ok=false;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const good=()=&gt;{ ok=true; vHideLoad(); };<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',good);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.addEventListener('canplay',good);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.addEventListener('error',()=&gt;{ if(!ok) vInfo('这个视频无法在浏览器中播放','常见原因是封装或编码不被支持（MKV / AVI / RMVB / HEVC / AC3 等）。下载后用本机播放器打开。'); });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; v.src=u;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; body.appendChild(v);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; vActions(item,kind);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(kind==='audio'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; body.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const box=document.createElement('div'); box.className='audiobox';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const big=document.createElement('div'); big.className='big';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; big.appendChild(svgIcon('M9 18V6l11-2v12M9 18a2.5 2.5 0 11-5 0 2.5 2.5 0 015 0zm11-2a2.5 2.5 0 11-5 0 2.5 2.5 0 015 0z','#b98ae0',false));<br>

&nbsp; &nbsp; box.appendChild(big); box.appendChild(nm); box.appendChild(as); box.appendChild(a);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; body.appendChild(box);<br>

&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
<br>

&nbsp;&nbsp;vActions(item,kind);<br>
}<br>
<br>
async function renderText(item,u){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;vLoad('正在读取文本…');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const MAX=4*1024*1024;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const ctl=new AbortController();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;viewer.ctl=ctl;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; /* Everything 的 HTTP 服务有个坑：Range 的「结束位置」&gt;= 文件长度时不会自动收敛，<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 而是声明一个更大的 Content-Length 后直接断连（IncompleteRead）。<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; 所以必须先拿到准确的文件大小，再把结尾钳到 size-1；能不用 Range 就不用。 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; let size=null, truncated=false;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const raw=String(item.size==null?'':item.size).trim();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(/^\d+$/.test(raw)){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const n=Number(raw);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if(isFinite(n)&amp;&amp;n&gt;0) size=n;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(size==null){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;/* 大小未知：用 1 字节探测请求，从 Content-Range 换出总长度 */<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;try{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const probe=await fetch(u,{credentials:'same-origin',cache:'no-store',signal:ctl.signal,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; headers:{'Range':'bytes=0-0'}});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!probe.ok&amp;&amp;probe.status!==206) throw new Error('HTTP '+probe.status);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;const t=totalFromRange(probe.headers.get('Content-Range'));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if(t!=null) size=t;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;try{ await probe.arrayBuffer(); }catch(e){}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}catch(e){ /* 探测失败 → 按无 Range 处理，交给下面的兜底 */ }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if(ctl.signal.aborted) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const opts={credentials:'same-origin',cache:'no-store',signal:ctl.signal,headers:{}};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(size!=null &amp;&amp; size&gt;MAX){ opts.headers.Range='bytes=0-'+(MAX-1); truncated=true; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; let r=await fetch(u,opts);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(!r.ok &amp;&amp; r.status!==206) throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; let buf=await r.arrayBuffer();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(ctl.signal.aborted) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(size==null){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;const t=totalFromRange(r.headers.get('Content-Range'));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;size=t!=null?t:buf.byteLength;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;if(size&gt;buf.byteLength) truncated=true;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(buf.byteLength&gt;MAX){ buf=buf.slice(0,MAX); truncated=true; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const text=decodeText(buf,truncated);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const lines=text.length?text.split('\n').length:0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const pre=document.createElement('pre');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pre.className='textview'+(viewer.wrap?' wrap':'');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; pre.textContent=text||'（空文件）';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const body=$('#vBody');<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; body.className='vbody plain'; body.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; body.appendChild(pre);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; vMeta(item,(lines?lines+' 行':'')+(truncated?' · 仅前 4MB':''));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const box=$('#vActs'); box.textContent='';<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const tg=vBtn('自动换行',IP.wrap,false,()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;viewer.wrap=!viewer.wrap;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;pre.classList.toggle('wrap',viewer.wrap);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tg.classList.toggle('pri',viewer.wrap);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; tg.classList.toggle('pri',viewer.wrap);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; box.appendChild(tg);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; box.appendChild(vBtnDownload(item,u));<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; box.appendChild(vBtn('复制路径',IP.copy,false,()=&gt;copyText(joinPath(item))));<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}catch(e){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(ctl.signal.aborted) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; vInfo('无法读取这个文件','可能是权限不足、文件太大，或服务器拒绝访问。');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
}<br>
<br>
function openViewer(item){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!item||item.type==='folder') return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;viewer.item=item; viewer.open=true;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#vName').textContent=item.name||'';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const full=joinPath(item);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#vPath').textContent=full; $('#vPath').title=full;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;vMeta(item); <br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#vBody').className='vbody'; $('#vBody').textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#vActs').textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#viewer').hidden=false;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;lockScroll();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;renderPreview(item);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!viewer.pushed){ viewer.pushed=true; try{ history.pushState({ev:1},'',location.href); }catch(e){} }<br>
}<br>
function closeViewer(useHistory){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(!viewer.open) return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;viewer.open=false;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const body=$('#vBody');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$$('video,audio',body).forEach(media=&gt;{ try{ media.pause(); }catch(e){} media.removeAttribute('src'); try{ media.load(); }catch(e){} });<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(viewer.ctl){ try{ viewer.ctl.abort(); }catch(e){} viewer.ctl=null; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;clearTimeout(viewer.loadTimer); viewer.loadTimer=null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;body.textContent=''; body.className='vbody';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#vActs').textContent='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#viewer').hidden=true;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;unlockScroll();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;viewer.item=null;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(useHistory&amp;&amp;viewer.pushed){ viewer.pushed=false; ignorePop++; history.back(); }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else viewer.pushed=false;<br>
}<br>
<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 事件绑定 ======================= */<br>
$('#vClose').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;closeViewer(true));<br>
$('#viewer').addEventListener('click',e=&gt;{ if(e.target===$('#vBody')&amp;&amp;!$('#vBody').querySelector('img,video,audio,iframe,pre')) closeViewer(true); });<br>
<br>
$('#form').addEventListener('submit',e=&gt;{ e.preventDefault(); $('#q').blur(); runSearch(true); });<br>
$('#q').addEventListener('input',()=&gt;{ $('.searchwrap').classList.toggle('has-value',!!$('#q').value); });<br>
$('#clearBtn').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#q').value=''; $('.searchwrap').classList.remove('has-value');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.q='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.quick){ runSearch(false); $('#q').focus(); return; }&nbsp;&nbsp;/* 还留着「图片/视频」过滤，继续列出来 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#results').textContent=''; $('#morewrap').innerHTML='';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.browse=null; state.mode='idle'; paintHome(); status(''); syncUrl(false);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#q').focus();<br>
});<br>
$('#sortSel').addEventListener('change',()=&gt;{ state.sort=$('#sortSel').value; store.set('sort',state.sort); reloadCurrent(); });<br>
$('#ascBtn').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{ state.asc=!state.asc; store.set('asc',state.asc); paintControls(); reloadCurrent(); });<br>
$('#pageSel').addEventListener('change',()=&gt;{ state.pageSize=Number($('#pageSel').value); store.set('pageSize',state.pageSize); reloadCurrent(); });<br>
$$('#filters .chip[data-flag]').forEach(b=&gt;b.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const k=b.dataset.flag; state.flags[k]=!state.flags[k];<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const map={caseSensitive:'case',wholeword:'wholeword',path:'path',regex:'regex'};<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;store.set(map[k],state.flags[k]);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;paintControls();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;reloadCurrent();<br>
}));<br>
<br>
/* 图片 / 视频 快捷过滤：互斥开关，关了恢复全部 */<br>
$$('#filters .chip[data-quick]').forEach(b=&gt;b.addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const k=b.dataset.quick;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.quick = state.quick===k ? null : k;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;store.set('quick',state.quick||'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.quick &amp;&amp; state.mode==='browse') state.browseType='all';&nbsp;&nbsp;/* ext: 只会命中文件，别再叠加文件夹筛选 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;paintControls();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.mode==='browse'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; syncUrl(true);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; paintBrowseBar();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; loadBrowse(true);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}else{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; runSearch(true);&nbsp; &nbsp;/* 会把输入框里现有关键词一起带上 */<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
}));<br>
<br>
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(e.key==='Escape'){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(viewer.open){ closeViewer(true); return; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(document.activeElement===$('#q')){ $('#q').blur(); }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; closeSheets();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(viewer.open) return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(e.key==='/'&amp;&amp;document.activeElement!==$('#q')&amp;&amp;!/input|textarea|select/i.test(document.activeElement.tagName)){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; e.preventDefault(); $('#q').focus(); $('#q').select();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
});<br>
<br>
/* 抽屉 */<br>
function openSheet(id){ $('#mask').classList.add('show'); $(id).classList.add('show'); }<br>
function closeSheets(){ $('#mask').classList.remove('show'); $$('.sheet').forEach(s=&gt;s.classList.remove('show')); }<br>
$('#mask').addEventListener('click',closeSheets);<br>
$$('[data-close]').forEach(b=&gt;b.addEventListener('click',closeSheets));<br>
$$('.sheet .grab').forEach(g=&gt;g.addEventListener('click',closeSheets));<br>
$('#helpBtn').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;openSheet('#helpSheet'));<br>
<br>
function openCfg(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#cfgBase').value=state.base||'';<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;$('#cfgOrigin').textContent=location.href.replace(/#.*$/,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;openSheet('#cfgSheet');<br>
}<br>
$('#cfgSave').addEventListener('click',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;state.base=$('#cfgBase').value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g,'').replace(/\/+$/,'');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;store.set('base',state.base);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;closeSheets();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.mode==='search'){ load(true); } else { toast('已保存连接设置'); }<br>
});<br>
<br>
/* 首页点击：磁盘卡片 / 历史记录 */<br>
$('#home').addEventListener('click',e=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const x=e.target.closest('[data-hdel]');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(x){<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const t=x.dataset.hdel;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; state.history=state.history.filter(v=&gt;v!==t); store.set('history',state.history); paintHome();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const dr=e.target.closest('[data-dir]');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(dr){ enterBrowse(dr.dataset.dir); return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;const c=e.target.closest('[data-hq]');<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(c){ $('#q').value=c.dataset.hq; runSearch(true); }<br>
});<br>
<br>
/* 滚动自动加载 */<br>
let ticking=false;<br>
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(ticking) return;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;ticking=true;<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;requestAnimationFrame(()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; ticking=false;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(state.mode==='idle'||state.loading) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(state.shown&gt;=state.total) return;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const doc=document.documentElement;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; const top=window.scrollY||doc.scrollTop||0;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; if(top+window.innerHeight&gt;=doc.scrollHeight-600) loadMore();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
},{passive:true});<br>
<br>
/* 预览浮层的返回键 */<br>
window.addEventListener('popstate',()=&gt;{<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(ignorePop&gt;0){ ignorePop--; return; }<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(viewer.open) closeViewer(false);<br>
});<br>
<br>
/* 浏览器前进 / 后退 */<br>
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=&gt;{ if(!viewer.open) boot(); });<br>
<br>
/* 主题跟随系统变化 */<br>
window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme:dark)').addEventListener('change',()=&gt;{ if(state.theme==='auto') applyTheme(); });<br>
<br>
/* ======================= 启动 ======================= */<br>
function boot(){<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;readUrl();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;paintControls();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;if(state.browse) showBrowse();<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else if(state.q) runSearch(false);<br>
&nbsp;&nbsp;else resetHome();<br>
}<br>
applyTheme();<br>
paintControls();<br>
boot();<br>
})();<br>
&lt;/script&gt;<br>
